title: feat(gen): keep sandboxes running past 24 hours through E2B's timeout
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: Added sandbox keeps through E2B's existing timeout API, allowing unmodified E2B SDKs and CLI to request runs beyond E2B's 24-hour limit. A timeout over 24 hours on create, setTimeout, or connect with a key records a sandbox_keep D1 row; a shorter timeout or pause removes it. A 10-minute cron renews kept sandboxes for up to an hour at a time through the E2B route using the requesting key, with the same budget checks and billing as manual renewal. It restarts runs before E2B's 24-hour cap and can resume a kept sandbox that paused. Keeps end at their timeout, on a 402 or 403, or when the key or sandbox is gone; each renewal is paid before it runs, so it creates no debt. The polli CLI adds sandbox create --timeout <s>, where 0 means no timeout, and sandbox pause <id>. The work incorporates D1 tracking, resume, and unpaid-stop ideas from #16858 by @afanasevmylife.
